testEvidence.macOSGhostty: PARTIAL_USER_REPORTED_E2E: Main approved B-only passkey policy, previously forked Work detected and understood 1 change, Work generated an exact Handoff Brief, and Main displayed [compose_context_review_import] with policy freshness checked and source attribution. No independent Pi receipt/session log or full resilience tests.

nonGoals: automatic product policy adoption from Work
knownLimitations: Natural-language approval extraction accuracy and recall have not been evaluated against real model responses; false approvals or missed decisions remain possible.

Approval scanner evaluates up to three unreviewed candidates per settle; remaining candidates are exported as unresolved freshness rather than silently marked complete. Further Main activity is needed to drain backlog.
The owner-main default delivers decisions to all of that Main's linked Work agents. Semantic domain relevance filtering has not been validated.
Automatic stop enforcement only handles explicit all-Work stops. Ambiguous or single-Work stop scope is not automatically published.
A delivered policy is not proof that Work changed files or passed tests. No verified applied-state receipt exists yet.
An already-running tool cannot be retroactively cancelled. Stop takes effect on subsequent tool-call boundaries.
B-option resolution can still be ambiguous when source has been compacted or heavily ContextEdited; it is held rather than guessed.
Actual npm typecheck and Node tests are unexecuted because the GitHub connector has no runner and this environment cannot fetch the repo/dependencies.
macOS/Ghostty partial user-reported Main→Work policy propagation succeeded; native Split, full Handoff and branch/offline scenarios still require validation.
Draft PR #37 is dependent on unmerged Draft PR #25. Neither main nor the internal development harness has been changed.

Observed user scenario (B approval → ask_user documentation-only → original warning): user subsequently confirmed Main decision auto-recorded and existing Work received/understood the change. Actual source logs, typecheck, and Handoff E2E remain unverified.

userReportedScenarios.scenario: B option approved, documentation selected, original ambiguous warning recovered; Main reported '확정된 Main 결정이 Work 동기화 기록에 반영됐습니다.'

userReportedScenarios.scenario: Work → Main Handoff: user supplied Main-side [compose_context_review_import] showing four work-reported claims, original quoted constraints/WHY, policy freshness 'checked', source Work session, and explicit no-policy-authority framing.
userReportedScenarios.limitations: Visible import message confirms end-to-end display, but not internal persistent receipt, comparison-model absence from logs, test execution, or independent truth of Work's file/status claims.

qualityFindings.evidence: User-supplied Handoff repeats one file-creation result as four numbered claims and reprints same scope/verification facts across summary, verbatim quotes and WHY/conditions.
qualityFindings.improvementDirection: Keep a concise Main-facing outcome, changed file, policy decision and rationale, test/verification status, unresolved items; retain full provenance in expandable or inspectable evidence and avoid redundant repeated excerpts.
